card.name: Time-of-day words like daytime
card.fires_on: The word daytime (also afternoon, decades, duly) right after a verb or linking word, mostly in sleep-drug warnings about sedation or doses. A few hits are odd stray pieces in unrelated text.

modes.description: Words like duly or decades, or parts of foreign or Sanskrit terms, in general web text.
